summary: "Children of the Bush" by Henry Lawson is a collection of short stories written during the late 19th century. Through various interactions and humorous exchanges, we see the Giraffe’s unwavering goodwill and his tendency to help others in distress, setting the tone for the stories that celebrate the resilience and generosity of those living in the bush.
